correctness.rationale: The source quartic has 19 F3 and 199 F9 singular-surface rational points by independent exhaustive enumerations of 40 and 820 projective classes. Three non-split A3 chains contribute respectively +3 and +27 points each to the resolution, giving Y(F3)=28 and Y(F9)=280. Published Hoang–Shimada geometry puts all 49 spanning divisor classes over F9, hence geometric Frobenius squared acts as 9 on 22-dimensional H2; eigenvalues therefore ±3. The F3 Lefschetz trace 28=1+9+3(a-b), a+b=22 gives (a,b)=(14,8). K3 Tate/divisor spanning yields rank 14 over F3, 22 over F9. Source CHECK.py inspected; independent_checks.py independently reproduced both point counts and resolution corrections. The published geometric spanning and component descent are inputs, not proved by finite enumeration.
